comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a robot-axis damper; record rights and parks a tipped mini glue gun with its hot nozzle off the mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool insertion, controlled small-angle adjustment, counterholding, tightening, and test cycling; record requires grasping, reorientation, and stable placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate measures dynamic stops and setting retention. Record requires upright parking and nozzle clearance but provides no body, specs, stability duration, or clearance threshold.
comparison.reason: Safe reorientation and parking of a handheld tool does not test mechanical tuning or damping response.
